verdict.rationale: The Apple M4 Pro is a processor (SoC), not a software product with an interface that could run headlessly or be invoked in CI, so this story is a category error for this kind of product. Headless operation and CI integration belong to the operating system and tooling layered on top. The only nearby evidence is a claim that Xcode simulator testing runs faster, which is a hardware performance statement, not a headless or CI capability of the chip.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
